statement: Compactness of natural-isomorphism spaces, using closures of finite-stage comparisons, supplies coherent realization and ordinary-pro étale slices.
Pinned ordinary pro-points are rational points; comparison of completed Kummer classes occurs after one finitely generated source refinement.
For finitely generated A subset B, image of completed A multiplicative group intersects B multiplicative group exactly in A multiplicative group.

Every fixed source-field representative of a pinned ordinary pro-morphism reconstructs as a scheme morphism after absolute weak normalization; all étale slice comparisons reconstruct over that same field.
Ordinary relative pro-reconstruction with pinned underlying limit map holds for every characteristic-zero field, including infinite transcendence degree.
